resources.string: Lets Jarvis read what is on the screen and tap, type and scroll for you when you give it a voice command. Screen contents are sent to the AI provider you choose in the Jarvis app.
Jarvis closed unexpectedly last time. Sharing the report helps get it fixed.
Try “%1$s, text Mum I’m on my way”
Turn Jarvis on to start listening
Jarvis still needs: %1$s. Tap to finish setup.
Voice: George and Lewis sound most like the films
Needs an internet connection. If the voice can\'t be reached, Jarvis uses Kokoro or the phone\'s voice instead.
Start when the phone turns on
Talk over Jarvis, or say \"stop\", and it stops and listens. Keeps the microphone on while it speaks, with echo cancellation.
For a few seconds after answering, you can carry on without repeating the wake word.
Things Jarvis should know about you
e.g. My wife is saved as \"Amaka\" in WhatsApp
One per line, e.g. WhatsApp: the search icon is at the top right
Show the task island at the top while Jarvis works
Add an English phrase to use alongside Hey Jarvis. Clear it to use the default.
Use English letters and spaces, up to 40 characters.
Download the Kokoro voice first. Playing the system voice for now.
On this phone Kokoro takes %1$.1f seconds to make each second of speech, so it pauses between phrases. A cloud voice or the phone\'s own voice won\'t pause.
Get a key at platform.openai.com → API keys. If you\'ve added an OpenAI model, its key is used automatically.
alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, onyx, nova, sage, shimmer or verse
Get a key at elevenlabs.io → Developers → API keys.
A voice ID from your ElevenLabs voice library. The default is George, a warm British voice.
Get a key at fish.audio → API keys.
The ID of a voice on fish.audio (open the voice and copy the ID from its page). Leave empty for the default voice.
Any server with an OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, such as Kokoro-FastAPI on your computer. A key is optional.
The voice name your server expects.
Let cloud AI see my memories
Remember what tasks I have done
Use the on-device model built into Jarvis
Allow the model download on mobile data
This build has no on-device runtime. The model in Termux or your cloud models are used instead.
On-device model: installed. It starts when needed and stops after a while to save memory.
The on-device model (about 1 GB) is not downloaded yet.
No on-phone model is set up. Add one on the Models page, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1.
On-phone model (%1$s): not running. Jarvis starts it through Termux when needed.
Short, simple questions use the model on your phone. Hard, current-events or Hindi questions use your cloud models when the internet works.
Cloud models first, the on-phone model if the internet is down.
Only the on-phone model answers. Nothing leaves your phone.
Uses Google speech recognition (needs the Google app; it may use the internet). Wake word still works offline. Replies are spoken in English.
Offline recognition on your phone. English only.
Jarvis uses your primary model (★). Tap a model to edit it or make it primary.
Add Claude, OpenAI, or a model running on your own computer with LM Studio or Ollama.
If the primary model can\'t be reached (offline, out of credit, server down), Jarvis carries on with your other models, top to bottom.
Effort: lower is faster, higher is more careful
Jarvis will stop using this model.
Get an API key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys. Low effort makes phone tasks noticeably faster.
Get an API key at platform.openai.com → API keys. Use any model that supports tool calling.

On your computer: open LM Studio → Developer → start the server and turn on \"Serve on Local Network\". Enter your computer\'s IP address below and load a model that supports tool calling (e.g. Qwen).
On your computer, start Ollama with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 so the phone can reach it, then enter your computer\'s IP address below. Use a model that supports tool calling.
Get an API key at openrouter.ai/keys. Use any model ID listed on the site.
Get an API key at aistudio.google.com → Get API key.
Get an API key at console.groq.com/keys.
Any server with an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint and tool calling.
Go to the app without activating
I can run your phone for you. Say \"Hey Jarvis\" and tell me what you need: send a message, open an app, change a setting.\n\nLet\'s get me set up. It takes about two minutes.
I need the microphone to hear \"Hey Jarvis\" and your commands. Listening for the wake word happens entirely on your phone.

To tap, type and scroll for you, Android needs you to switch on Jarvis in Accessibility settings:

1. Tap Open settings below
2. Find Installed apps (or Downloaded apps)
3. Tap Jarvis phone control and switch it on
Greyed out or says \"Restricted setting\"? Open Jarvis\'s app info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Allow Jarvis to run in the background so I can still hear \"Hey Jarvis\" when your screen is off.\n\nOn Samsung, Xiaomi and some other phones, also set Jarvis\'s battery setting to \"Unrestricted\".

Three downloads that run entirely on your phone: the \"Hey Jarvis\" listener, speech recognition for your commands, and Kokoro, a natural-sounding voice. Use Wi-Fi if you can. You can carry on while they download.
Choose the AI that does the thinking: Claude, OpenAI, or a model on your own computer with LM Studio or Ollama. You can add more later and pick a primary one.
I\'ll think with %1$s. You can add more models and change the primary one on the Models page.
Say \"Hey Jarvis\" any time, or tap the mic in the app. Try: \"Hey Jarvis, message my wife on WhatsApp and tell her I love her.\"
Lets Jarvis tap, type and scroll for you
Keeps Jarvis listening with the screen off
Tap \"Installed apps\" (or \"Downloaded apps\"), then \"Jarvis phone control\", and switch it on.
Find Jarvis in the list and set it to \"Don\'t optimise\" or \"Unrestricted\".
Tap a task to review each step. Hold a task to delete it.
Things you asked Jarvis to remember, and app names you taught it. Tap a note to edit it, hold any row to delete it. They stay on this phone.
Nothing saved yet. Try saying: \"Hey Jarvis, remember that I prefer short answers.\"
Delete all saved tasks and their steps?
Delete everything Jarvis remembers? This cannot be undone.
No steps were recorded for this task.
